phrases.translation: สวัสดีครับ/ค่ะ
phrases.note: Men say khrap, women say kha — the ending particle marks the speaker's gender, not the listener's.

phrases.translation: ขอบคุณครับ/ค่ะ

phrases.note: Thai doesn't have a direct everyday equivalent to English "please" — this word exists but reads as formal/written, closer to signage than casual speech.
